title: SecMesh-PQSI: Formal Algebraic and Information-Theoretic Foundations and Cryptographic Defense Engine for Post-Quantum and Post-Super-Intelligence Meshes
description: Clean-room cryptographic refactoring of legacy SecMesh rebuilt atop Tsotchke's cryptographic, representation-theoretic, and quantum-geometry stack into a Post-Quantum and Post-Super-Intelligence (information-theoretic) mesh defense engine, backed by 27 zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 theorems verified across all six independent proof kernels, bit-exact C11 Moonlab <-> OpenSSL 3.5.5 FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 interoperability, live Eshkol AD modules, and two companion AMS-LaTeX white papers.
